abstract: In hit‐driven industries, product development is associated with a right‐skewed unconditional distribution of performance, and products in the right tail have outsized impacts. Understanding how exceptional performance is generated can improve resource allocation, but the literature advances two different narratives: one emphasizes postrelease demand discovery, and the other emphasizes prerelease factors, including project quality, management teams, and uncertainties associated with product development. The model in this paper facilitates assessing the relative importance of the different narratives. Estimation employs data on movies—the primary setting where demand discovery has been emphasized. The results reject the primacy of demand discovery; most project‐specific variation in return‐on‐investment is associated with uncertainty resolved during product development. Higher managerial ability is associated with better product‐development performance. Parameter estimates are compatible with nearly efficient and approximately positive assortative matching of projects and managers. The results suggest that emphasizing prerelease factors should be the presumptive narrative in all hit‐driven industries.
abstract_zh: 在热门驱动型行业中，产品开发与右偏的无条件绩效分布相关联，右尾产品具有超常影响力。理解卓越绩效如何产生有助于优化资源配置，但文献中提出了两种不同的叙事：一种强调发布后的需求发现，另一种则强调发布前的因素，包括项目质量、管理团队及产品开发相关的不确定性。本文构建的模型有助于评估不同叙事的相对重要性。估计采用电影数据——这是需求发现被强调的主要场景。结果否定了需求发现的首要地位；投资回报中大部分项目特定变异与产品开发期间解决的不确定性相关。更高的管理能力与更好的产品开发绩效相关联。参数估计与项目和管理者之间近乎高效且近似正选型匹配相容。结果表明，在所有热门驱动型行业中，强调发布前因素应成为默认叙事。
title: Somebody Knows Something: Managerial Ability, Product Development, and Return‐on‐Investment in a Hit‐Driven Industry
title_zh: 有人知道些什么：经理能力、产品开发与热门驱动型行业的投资回报

abstract: Access to public data is essential for improving ESG performance, which has not been explored in previous literature. Using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2009 to 2023, we conduct a quasi-natural experiment to explore the impact of public data accessibility on corporate ESG performance. The study finds that the public data policy promotes corporate ESG performance directly. Mechanism analysis reveals that public data accessibility improves ESG performance by reducing information asymmetry, improving corporate innovation capacity, and enhancing firm value. Public data’s quality, volume, and update frequency influence ESG performance. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that firms in regions with lower levels of economic development, less marketization, and weaker stakeholder orientation; those operating in competitive and polluting industries; and those with lower digitalization and unstable operations stand to benefit more from the public data accessibility. This study not only enriches our understanding of the positive effect of government intervention on ESG practices but also provides valuable insights for guiding corporations towards sustainable development and reducing inequality.

title: From data accessibility to ESG excellence: a quasi-natural experiment

abstract: Abstract Stocks that are expensive to borrow underperform significantly and for long periods of time. Every share must be held by an investor who does not lend it out and, hence, loses money. I find no evidence that investors hold these stocks in anticipation of lending them in the future. Instead, investors appear to hold these stocks for short-term trading. When turnover is high, high-fee stocks are overpriced and underperform. When turnover is low, high-fee stock prices are low, and they earn positive returns. More Robinhood investors hold shares when turnover is high than when it is low.
abstract_zh: 摘要 借入成本高昂的股票在长期内表现显著不佳。每一股都必须由不出借且因此亏损的投资者持有。我未发现证据表明投资者持有这些股票是预期未来将其出借。相反，投资者似乎出于短期交易目的持有这些股票。当换手率高时，高费用股票被高估并表现不佳。当换手率低时，高费用股票价格较低，并产生正回报。相较于换手率低时，换手率高时更多Robinhood投资者持有股份。
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Why Do Investors Hold Overpriced Shares?
title_zh: 投资者为何持有定价过高的股票？

abstract: This paper applies panel data of listed companies in China between 2011 and 2021, combined with city-level digital finance indices, to examine the impact of regional digital finance development on local corporate performance. The results clearly indicate that regional digital finance development significantly enhances local corporate performance. Specifically, digital finance mitigates financial constraints, increases the proportion of liquid assets and curtails earnings management, thereby further increasing corporate performance. This promotional effect is particularly pronounced among small and micro-sized companies, non-state-owned enterprise, and companies with weak bank-corporate relationships. This study supplements research on the economic consequences of digital finance development and the influencing factors of company performance, providing a theoretical basis and empirical evidence for the high-quality development of the real economy facilitated by digital finance advancements.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2011年至2021年中国上市公司面板数据，结合城市级数字金融指数，考察了区域数字金融发展对当地企业绩效的影响。结果明确显示，区域数字金融发展显著提升了当地企业绩效。具体而言，数字金融缓解了融资约束，增加了流动资产比例并抑制了盈余管理，从而进一步提升了企业绩效。这一促进作用在小型微型企业、非国有企业以及与银行关系较弱的企业中尤为显著。本研究补充了关于数字金融发展的经济后果及企业绩效影响因素的研究，为数字金融发展促进实体经济高质量发展提供了理论依据和实证证据。

title: Can digital finance improve corporate performance? Evidence from China
title_zh: 数字金融能否提升企业绩效？来自中国的证据

abstract: Against the policy backdrop of Digital China and the national campaign to enhance digital literacy and skills, this paper uses nationally representative 2019 China Household Finance Survey (CHFS) data to examine the impact of digital literacy on individuals’ economic expectations. We employ an ordered logistic regression and conduct robustness checks (alternative estimators, variable/sample substitutions, and instrumental variables). Empirical analysis reveals a counterintuitive ‘capability paradox’: individuals with higher digital literacy display more pessimistic expectations. Mechanism analysis shows that increased attention to financial and economic information is the key mediating channel. We further propose that two dimensions of the information ecosystem moderate this path: information overload (raising cognitive load and decision fatigue) and a negative media environment (activating negativity bias), which together amplify the effect of heightened information attention on pessimism. Financial literacy exhibits a similar paradox. These findings challenge the traditional digital empowerment narrative and suggest a coordinated policy response that pairs literacy promotion with proactive governance of the information environment to help stabilize expectations.
abstract_zh: 在数字中国建设与全民数字素养与技能提升行动的政策背景下，本文利用具有全国代表性的2019年中国家庭金融调查（CHFS）数据，考察数字素养对个体经济预期的影响。我们采用有序逻辑回归模型，并进行稳健性检验（包括替代估计方法、变量与样本替换以及工具变量法）。实证分析揭示了一个反直觉的“能力悖论”：数字素养越高的个体，其经济预期反而越悲观。机制分析表明，对财经信息关注度的提升是关键的中介渠道。我们进一步提出，信息生态系统的两个维度对这一路径具有调节作用：信息过载（提高认知负荷与决策疲劳）和负面媒体环境（激活消极偏差），二者共同放大了信息关注度提升对悲观预期的促进效应。金融素养同样表现出类似的悖论。上述发现对传统的数字赋能叙事构成挑战，并提示应采取协同政策应对，将素养提升与信息环境的主动治理相结合，以助力稳定预期。

title: The digital literacy dilemma: how information overload and negative media amplify economic gloom
title_zh: 数字素养困境：信息过载与负面媒体如何加剧经济悲观情绪

abstract: In the post-epidemic era, as China’s economy slows and the risk exposure of various sectors gradually increases, research on the risk contribution of sectors should be strengthened. This study introduces the TVM-MIDAS Copula-MES approach, which considers tail dependencies with asymmetric long memory when capturing the systemic risk contribution of Chinese sectors. We find that incorporating the asymmetric long memory feature of tail dependence can enhance the accuracy of both model fitting and measurement of systematic risk contribution. Furthermore, aside from the consumer sector, all other sectors show some degree of tail-dependent long memory. Compared to other sectors, real estate displays significant long memory in both upper and lower tail dependencies, while the materials and medical sectors exhibit the strongest long memory in upper and lower tail dependencies, respectively. Additionally, during the US subprime crisis, the Chinese financial sector contributed significantly more to systemic risk than other sectors, whereas during the Chinese stock market crash, its contribution was the opposite. Throughout the COVID-19 pandemic, the systemic risk contribution of all Chinese sectors remained relatively stable. Moreover, the Chinese utilities sector has the smallest systematic risk contribution overall, while the information technology sector shows the opposite trend.
abstract_zh: 后疫情时代，随着中国经济增速放缓及各行业风险敞口逐步增大，加强行业风险贡献研究显得尤为重要。本研究引入TVM-MIDAS Copula-MES方法，在捕捉中国行业系统性风险贡献时，考虑了具有非对称长记忆性的尾部依赖特征。研究发现，纳入尾部依赖的非对称长记忆特性能够提升模型拟合及系统性风险贡献度量的准确性。此外，除消费行业外，其他行业均表现出一定程度的尾部依赖长记忆性。与其他行业相比，房地产行业在上尾和下尾依赖中均展现出显著的长记忆性，而材料行业和医疗行业分别在上尾和下尾依赖中表现出最强的长记忆性。同时，在美国次贷危机期间，中国金融行业对系统性风险的贡献显著高于其他行业，而在中国股市崩盘期间，其贡献则呈现相反趋势。在整个COVID-19疫情期间，中国各行业的系统性风险贡献保持相对稳定。此外，中国公用事业行业的系统性风险贡献总体最小，而信息技术行业则呈现相反趋势。

title: Measuring systemic risk contributions in the Chinese sector using the dynamic tail dependence with asymmetric long memory
title_zh: 基于非对称长记忆动态尾部依赖的中国部门系统性风险贡献测度

abstract: This article examines the effect of COVID-19 vaccination on the disease dynamics in Moscow using an instrumental variables (IV) approach. Based on weekly data on cases, deaths, and mobility, I compare ordinary least squares (OLS) results with two-stage least squares (TSLS) estimates, addressing endogeneity in vaccination and behaviour. The TSLS estimates imply that the effect on new cases is about 10 times larger than suggested by OLS, indicating a substantial downward bias in naïve models. Moreover, the two doses of Sputnik V have distinct effects: the first mainly lowers infection risk, while the second notably reduces mortality among infected individuals. These findings underscore the importance of high vaccination coverage, clear public communication, and integration of behavioural dynamics as critical elements of public health policy in large urban settings.
abstract_zh: 本文采用工具变量（IV）方法，考察了COVID-19疫苗接种对莫斯科疾病动态的影响。基于每周病例、死亡及流动性数据，我将普通最小二乘法（OLS）结果与两阶段最小二乘法（TSLS）估计进行比较，以处理疫苗接种与行为中的内生性问题。TSLS估计表明，对新发病例的影响约为OLS所提示的10倍，表明朴素模型中存在显著的下行偏差。此外，Sputnik V疫苗的两剂接种具有不同效果：第一剂主要降低感染风险，而第二剂则显著降低感染者死亡率。这些发现强调了高疫苗接种覆盖率、清晰的公共沟通以及将行为动态纳入考量，作为大型城市环境中公共卫生政策关键要素的重要性。
title: Instrumental variables analysis of COVID-19 vaccination in Moscow
title_zh: 莫斯科新冠疫苗接种的工具变量分析

abstract: We link records of firm investment to granular measures of extreme heat exposure for China’s listed companies from 2003 to 2019. We find that, for every ten additional days per year with days above 90°F, the investment rate decreases by an average of 0.2% points. Furthermore, our findings suggest that extremely high temperatures lead to increased volatility in corporate operating income. Companies tend to reduce long-term debt and increase cash holdings to cope with the increased uncertainty. Notably, corporate investments with tighter financing constraints are more negatively impacted by extremely high temperatures. Heterogeneity analysis revealed that the impact is primarily concentrated among small and private enterprises, as well as enterprises with limited access to credit resources and those with more graphically concentrated subsidiaries.
abstract_zh: 我们将企业投资记录与中国上市公司2003年至2019年间极端高温暴露的精细度量数据相连接。研究发现，每年气温超过90华氏度的天数每增加十天，投资率平均下降0.2个百分点。此外，我们的结果表明，极端高温导致企业营业收入的波动性增大。为应对不确定性上升，企业倾向于减少长期债务并增加现金持有。值得注意的是，融资约束更紧的企业投资受极端高温的负面影响更为显著。异质性分析显示，这一影响主要集中在小型和私营企业，以及信贷资源获取受限和子公司地理分布更为集中的企业。

title: Mitigating the impact of extreme heat: spatial diversification and corporate investment
title_zh: 缓解极端高温影响：空间多元化与企业投资

abstract: Accounting estimates are crucial in financial reports, especially in the insurance industry, where actuaries’ estimates of future claims reserves directly affect corporate financial transparency and operational decisions. Existing research has revealed the uncertainty and subjectivity of traditional accounting estimation methods, and has recognized the positive role of machine learning, but pure machine learning faces the challenge of insufficient interpretability. Based on financial data of Chinese property insurance companies from 2014 to 2022, this paper selects five major insurance types, adopts three machine learning algorithms: random forest, gradient boosting machine, and NGBoost to predict future losses, and compares them with actuary predictions. The results show that the machine learning models are superior to actuary predictions in terms of indicators such as mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean square error (RMSE). After incorporating actuary prediction data into the model, accuracy and reliability are significantly improved. On this basis, this paper analyzes the interpretability of the optimal machine learning model through feature importance ranking, verifies the value of actuary predictions, and provides a feasible path for actuaries to transform into algorithm supervisors and auditors.
abstract_zh: 会计估计在财务报告中至关重要，尤其在保险行业中，精算师对未来索赔准备金的估计直接影响企业财务透明度及经营决策。现有研究已揭示传统会计估计方法的不确定性和主观性，并认识到机器学习的积极作用，但纯机器学习面临可解释性不足的挑战。基于2014年至2022年中国财产保险公司的财务数据，本文选取五大险种，采用随机森林、梯度提升机及NGBoost三种机器学习算法预测未来损失，并与精算师预测进行比较。结果显示，机器学习模型在平均绝对误差（MAE）和均方根误差（RMSE）等指标上优于精算师预测。将精算师预测数据纳入模型后，准确性和可靠性显著提升。在此基础上，本文通过特征重要性排序分析最优机器学习模型的可解释性，验证了精算师预测的价值，并为精算师转型为算法监督者和审计师提供了可行路径。

title: An empirical study on machine learning-based future loss prediction for insurance firms: evidence from China’s property and casualty insurance sector
